item: Gain on sale of equity interest in PRefChem (Malaysia) to PETRONAS [register O-2222-01]
line_item: Gain on sale of equity interest in an affiliate (inside operating income)
company_adjusted_measure: Adjusted net income (non-IFRS) 9M2026 SAR 368,923m (Q3 2026: 116,995) vs IFRS net income 380,551; reconciles from consolidated net income, so BEFORE NCI; no attributable version given
comment: Reconciliation (p.15 summary; p.21 detail; p.16/p.19 EBIT bridge) starts from net income 380,551 incl. NCI 1,527 (attributable 379,024, p.27). The PRefChem gain is not itemised: it sits inside "(Gains) losses on sales, retirements and disposals" (24,656) for 9M, (25,931) for Q3, all Downstream. Other 9M adjusting items: replacement cost (5,745); impairment and HFS remeasurement 1,908; HFS-period losses 2,580; commodity derivatives 5,145; JV/associate adjustments (2,685); others 1,609; total adjusting items (21,844); adjusting items related to finance costs +7,628. "Tax and zakat adjustments" +2,588 (Q3 +3,743) is a single line that "includes the tax and zakat effect of the adjusting items listed and the deferred tax impact of certain transactions" (p.21 fn5), so no after-tax amount for the gain. Tax note 7 (p.37) shows only an aggregate "(income) loss not subject to tax at statutory rates and other" of (35,616) for 9M and (21,723) for Q3, not linked to the gain. Note 16(a) (p.42) gives no tax or attribution. The FY2025 AFS note 40 (p.83) lists PRefChem as a 50% joint operation at "effective ownership", which points to no NCI share, but no filing states it. 6.8% of 9M2026 NI_ATTR 379,024.

item: Impairment and held-for-sale remeasurement losses: downstream PP&E impairment 14,569 (incl. 4,452 write-down for an international facility closure), SABIC Europe 8,640, SABIC ETP 4,755, other
line_item: Impairment and held for sale remeasurement losses (operating costs)
company_adjusted_measure: No FY2025 adjusted net income in the archive. Pieces only: 9M2025 (amended) impairment adjusting item 8,886 with aggregate tax/zakat adjustment (2,377) (2026_Q3 p.21); Q4 2025 impairment adjusting item 23,539 with aggregate tax/zakat adjustment +585 (2026_Q1 p.17); both before NCI; not summed (different bases)
comment: Tax: the tax reconciliation (p.45) has only an aggregate "loss not subject to tax at statutory rates and other" of 9,723; the deferred-tax movement (p.47) has no impairment line. NCI: SABIC and SABIC Europe are at 70% effective ownership (p.79-80), so NCI bears part of the 13,395 SABIC EP/ETP losses, but the share is not disclosed; the entity mix of the downstream PP&E impairment is not given. The segment footnote (p.36) says Downstream EBIT includes 20,363 relating to HFS assets. Other Aramco items FY2022-9M2026 (FY2022 impairment 3,690; FY2023 Hadeed 3,219 and impairment 3,110; FY2024 11,834; 9M2025 8,886) are each below 5% of attributable profit. 9.3% of FY2025 NI_ATTR 348,042.

item: Bargain purchase gains: Emerald Driller 244.9 and Seadrill GCC 177.3 [register O-2382-01]
comment: Special-purpose FS. Emerald sits in Corporate and Seadrill GCC in the KSA segment (p.32-33; note 5 p.35-36). The tax reconciliation (p.39) shows only an aggregate "non-taxable income" of (107.0), not tied to the gain. There is no statement on NCI (FY2022 NCI profit 7.174). 108.1% of FY2022 NI_ATTR 390.448.

comment: Candidate, not proposed for the register: FY2021 had a similar 215.9 charge (FY2020 9.6) and the filing does not call it non-recurring. Allowance rose to 470.2 (note 13). No tax or NCI disclosure. 60.6% of FY2022 NI_ATTR 390.448.

item: Unrealised gain on 16.5% Shelf Drilling stake held at FVTPL [register O-2382-03]
line_item: Gain on equity instruments designated at fair value through profit and loss
comment: Unrealised FV gain on 46m Shelf shares (cost 231.4, FV 317.1; 2025_Q3 note 15-c p.27). The interim tax note (2026_Q3 p.23) has no reconciliation and no item effect. There is no statement on NCI (9M2025 NCI 10.175). Also 9M2025: share-based payment 40.4 (6.8%), but annual grants recur (FY2024 110.6), so it is not listed. 14.4% of 9M2025 NI_ATTR 597.331.

item: Bargain purchase gain on acquisition of Saudi Arabian Saipem Ltd (provisional) [register O-2382-02]
comment: Provisional; it can change until 15 Sep 2027 (p.21). KSA segment (p.18). A deferred tax liability of 40.7 sits in the acquired net assets (p.20), but the tax treatment of the gain itself is not stated, and the interim tax note (p.23) has no reconciliation. "The Group acquired 100%"; the acquiring entity and any NCI share are not stated. ADES Saudi Ltd is 100% owned (FY2025 AFS p.16), but that is inference only. 16.9% of 9M2026 NI_ATTR 459.843.

item: Reversal of tax provisions (new; not in register)
line_item: Not stated (cash-flow add-back within profit before income tax and zakat)
comment: New candidate. It appears only in the cash-flow reconciliation (p.10), and no note explains it. FY2025 AFS note 21-a: tax provisions are mainly withholding taxes borne by the Group, and the Shelf acquisition brought in tax provisions of 470.0 (2026_Q3 p.22). It is added back to profit before income tax and zakat, so it sits above the tax line, but its P&L line, tax effect and NCI share are not disclosed. "Other expenses, net" rose to (154.2) from (42.4) without explanation. 13.9% of 9M2026 NI_ATTR 459.843.

item: Gain on remeasuring the previously held 16.5% Shelf Drilling stake on obtaining control (new; register has only 9M2025)
line_item: Gain on equity instruments designated at fair value through profit and loss
comment: Same stake as O-2382-03, but the FY2025 figure is missing from the register. The tax reconciliation (p.48) has only an aggregate "non-taxable income" of (133.6). There is no statement on NCI (FY2025 NCI 14.845). The Shelf bargain purchase gain of 21.209 (2.6%) is below threshold. 10.9% of FY2025 NI_ATTR 818.016.

item: Acquisition transaction cost (Shelf Drilling) (new)
comment: FY2024: 6.142. The accounting policy routes acquisition-related costs to this line. The tax reconciliation (p.48) shows only aggregate non-deductible expenses of 59.4. No NCI statement. 9.7% of FY2025 NI_ATTR 818.016.

item: Income from insurance claim (new)
line_item: Not stated (cash-flow add-back; face "Other income, net" is only 3.250)
comment: Shown only in the cash flow statement (add-back p.13; "insurance proceed received" 93.749 in investing). No note describes the claim or its P&L line. No tax or NCI disclosure. 11.5% of FY2025 NI_ATTR 818.016.

item: Impairment of two rigs after planned capex was cancelled (new)
comment: Recoverable amounts 2.9 and 14.1 (FVLCD). The group has no NCI: profit for the year equals profit attributable to equity holders. Tax: the reconciliation (p.45) has no item effect. The group pays zakat on its Saudi share and 20% income tax on its foreign share, so the effect cannot be read off. Liquidated damages of 61.8 are not listed because they are netted against deferred mobilisation revenue. 32.7% of FY2024 NI_ATTR 321.365.

comment: FVLCD-based (recoverable 43.1, 48.8, 45.0; note 4.2 p.34). No NCI in the group. The tax reconciliation (p.47) is aggregate only. % is of the absolute FY2025 loss. 152.0% of FY2025 NI_ATTR -75.250.

item: Gain on disposal of non-current assets held for sale (new)
comment: The insurance claim income of 7.121 in the same note is described by the company as arising "during normal course of business" (p.45), so it is not listed. No NCI in the group. Tax effect not disclosed. % is of the absolute FY2025 loss. 10.1% of FY2025 NI_ATTR -75.250.

comment: This is itself a tax charge, so it needs no further tax effect, and there is no NCI. It is still not determinable because the provision covers 2023-2025 together and the prior-year (one-off) part is not split from the 2025 part. % is of the absolute FY2025 loss. 13.4% of FY2025 NI_ATTR -75.250.

item: Gain on disposal of a land parcel (new)
comment: The insurance claim of about 7.1 in the same period is described as normal course of business (p.19). No NCI. The interim tax note (p.18) gives no item effect. 11.5% of 9M2025 NI_ATTR 73.268.

item: Non-refundable customer deposit retained after cancellation of a land-rig sale (new)
comment: No impairment was recognised in 9M2026: indicators were tested and recoverable amounts exceeded carrying amounts (p.16). No NCI. Tax effect not disclosed. 143.4% of 9M2026 NI_ATTR 6.902.

comment: Fleet-renewal gains are lumpy but recur (FY2021 0.058; FY2022 159.8; FY2023 214.1; FY2024 215.9; FY2025 5.8; 9M2026 115.8). The narrative lists them but does not remove them. Bahri has NCI (NCC 80%, Bahri Dry Bulk 60%), and no split is given. The zakat effect is not disclosed. 15.4% of FY2022 NI_ATTR 1,040.909.

item: Gains on disposal of property and equipment (vessels)
comment: See FY2022 row: recurring fleet-renewal gains. No NCI split, and the zakat effect is not disclosed. 13.3% of FY2023 NI_ATTR 1,613.428.

comment: An unusually large year for a recurring line (FY2022 17.0; FY2024 15.3; FY2025 67.4). Nature not described and not labelled non-recurring. No NCI split or zakat effect. 6.6% of FY2023 NI_ATTR 1,613.428.

comment: See FY2022 row. 9M2026 items (disposal gain 115.8; loss 119.0 on war-damaged vessel components) are each about 1% of 9M2026 attributable profit, and the 9M2026 profit jump is operational (Aramco-related revenue 20.9bn vs 3.4bn). 10.0% of FY2024 NI_ATTR 2,169.392.

item: Impairment charge on other real estate owned (new)

comment: Note 25.2 (p.61): OREO is acquired in the ordinary course, and the impairment followed independent valuations. ANB pays zakat on its Saudi share and income tax on its foreign share, and the effect of the charge is not disclosed. ANB has small NCI (FY2023 5.1), and the attribution is not stated. comment: The statements are image pages (p.10 income statement, p.14 cash flow; OCR). The face has no note reference, the cash flow has no related add-back, and no note explains the line. FY2024 was 0.061 and 9M2025 0.9. Other real estate of 265.9 was disposed of in 2025 (p.78), but the filing does not link it to this income. There is no NCI in FY2025 (NCI first appears in 9M2026), but the zakat effect is not disclosed. 22.0% of FY2025 NI_ATTR 2,431.485.

item: Gain on sale of other real estate (new)
comment: A related reversal of OREO impairment of 42.571 (separate line, 3.5%) arose from the same disposals (p.66). The bank has no NCI (all subsidiaries 100%), but the zakat and income tax effects are not disclosed. 5.5% of FY2024 NI_ATTR 1,230.954.

item: Prior-year zakat charge (equals the contested 2019 ZATCA assessment of 77.57) (new)
comment: The item is itself zakat expense, below profit before zakat, so it carries no further tax effect. The bank has no NCI: the income statement (p.8, image/OCR) has no NCI line and all subsidiaries are 100%. Prior-year zakat was (2.529) in FY2024 and (1.360) in FY2023. The bank is contesting the assessment at GSTC (p.83), so a later reversal is possible. FY2025 NI_ATTR excluding the item = 1,583.122 (our sum). 5.2% of FY2025 NI_ATTR 1,505.544.
